gbm_population_evidence.quote: History of a histologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma per 2021 WHO criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] TheraSphere GBM (other names: TheraSphere™ GBM Y-90 Glass Microspheres (TheraSphere GBM)): Single treatment of TheraSphere GBM device

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Feasibility Study to Evaluate the Safety of the TheraSphere Glioblastoma (GBM) Device in Patients With Recurrent GBM

coder_notes: The only intervention is the TheraSphere GBM Y-90 glass microsphere system, registered as a Device (endovascular radiotherapy); treated as device/radiotherapy and not listed as an agent, so no pharmacological candidate. Four parallel experimental groups differ by hemisphere/eloquence, none is a control.
